title.value: Does Pre-training Induce Systematic Inference? How Masked Language Models Acquire Commonsense Knowledge
title.justification: The paper title accurately reflects the main focus of the research, which is investigating whether pre-training of masked language models, such as BERT, induces systematic inference to acquire commonsense knowledge.
title.quote: Title extracted: 'Does Pre-training Induce Systematic Inference? How Masked Language Models Acquire Commonsense Knowledge'

extractions.description: This paper investigates whether pre-trained transformer models such as BERT acquire commonsense knowledge through systematic inference or merely recognize surface-level patterns. By inserting verbalized knowledge into the minibatches of a BERT model during pre-training, the study evaluates if such models improve their generalization to supported inferences. Findings suggest that commonsense knowledge is not acquired through systematic reasoning but rather from surface-level co-occurrence patterns.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The central theme of the paper is focused on the mechanisms through which BERT and similar models acquire commonsense knowledge, rather than any direct applications or implications for Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Resolving how models acquire commonsense knowledge has important implications. If models learn to make systematic inferences through pre-training, then scaling up pre-training is a promising direction for commonsense knowledge acquisition.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not focus on any of the listed Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development categories. Its content is centered around the technical exploration of language models and their learning capabilities.
primary_category.quote: We show that BERT does not acquire commonsense knowledge from premises and learned inferences. This highlights limitations of scaled pre-training and suggests developments in commonsense knowledge acquisition may require explicit reasoning mechanisms.
